prompt: Make a character MODEL SHEET of the character in the FIRST image, redrawn in a simplified, locked design that an animation team can repeat exactly in every drawing. The SECOND image is the style reference. The design, which replaces whatever the first image shows where they differ: Juno, a 15-year-old girl with tan skin. HAIR: short choppy teal hair, with ONE long thin lock hanging down in front of her RIGHT ear to her collarbone. GOGGLES: round brass-brown flight goggles with pale teal lenses, always pushed up on her forehead, never over her eyes. HEADPHONES: chunky grey-brown headphones, always resting round her neck on the collar, never on her ears. JACKET: a plain orange cropped flight jacket with a high stand-up collar, worn open, sleeves pushed up to the elbows; the back of the jacket is plain orange. PATCHES: exactly three plain flat one-colour patches on the jacket and nothing else on it: a YELLOW TRIANGLE on the outside of EACH upper sleeve (the same on her left sleeve and on her right sleeve), and a WHITE CIRCLE on her left chest; each patch is a single flat shape with a black outline and nothing inside it. SHIRT: a plain navy-blue shirt. GLOVES: grey-brown fingerless gloves on both hands (grey-brown, never teal, never green). TROUSERS: baggy dark-grey cargo trousers with one cream stripe down the outside of each leg and one cargo pocket on the outside of each thigh; gathered cuffs that sit over the tops of the shoes. SHOES: red-and-white high-top trainers with white laces and white soles, completely plain. FACE: plain, no scar, no marks. No pins, no badges, no emblems, no insignia, no stars, no lettering, no numbers, no logos and no brand marks anywhere on her. Layout of the sheet, on a plain pure white background: on the left, FOUR full-body drawings of her standing in a row, all the same height, feet on one line, left to right: (1) from straight in front, (2) three-quarter front view, turned toward the viewer's left, (3) exact side view facing the viewer's left, (4) from straight behind. She stands relaxed, arms a little away from the body, hands empty, mouth closed, calm. On the right, a column of four close-up callout drawings of her accessories, each drawn once, large and plain: the goggles, the headphones, one fingerless glove on a hand, one shoe from the side. The four full-body drawings show the SAME outfit with IDENTICAL colours and details; each patch stays on the same side of HER body in every view (a yellow triangle on each upper sleeve, so every view that shows a sleeve from outside shows its triangle; the white circle on her left chest, so the back view shows no circle). No hoverboard, no props. No text, no labels, no numbers, no arrows, no colour swatches, no borders, no ground line, no ground shadow. Style: 1990s cel anime: bold clean black ink outlines of even weight, flat colour fills, two tones per material (a base and one hard-edged shade), no gradients, no texture, no soft shading.
